images.title: Two groups of cards
images.purpose: Pose the opening puzzle as a picture: two groups of four number cards with the sums 19 and 21, and a question.
images.composition: Two paper trays with four number cards each, the sums under them and a question mark between.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. Two paper trays side by side. LEFT TRAY: a rectangle x 90 to 660, y 190 to 560 (570 by 370 px), white fill, dark #2B2B2B outline 3 px, with the label Group 1 in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (48 px) centred at x 375, y 150. Inside it 4 cards, each a rounded rectangle 110 by 140 px, y 250 to 390, filled teal #0072B2, outlined dark #2B2B2B 3 px, holding in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (80 px) the digits left to right: 1 at x 110 to 220; 2 at x 250 to 360; 7 at x 390 to 500; 9 at x 530 to 640. RIGHT TRAY: a rectangle x 796 to 1366, y 190 to 560, the same style, with the label Group 2 centred at x 1081, y 150, and inside it 4 cards, each a rounded rectangle 110 by 140 px, y 250 to 390, filled amber #E69F00, outlined dark #2B2B2B 3 px, holding in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (80 px) the digits left to right: 3 at x 816 to 926; 4 at x 956 to 1066; 5 at x 1096 to 1206; 9 at x 1236 to 1346. Under the left tray, centred at x 375, y 620, a rounded badge (x 245 to 505, y 590 to 670) with the text Sum 19 in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (56 px); under the right tray, centred at x 1081, y 620, a rounded badge (x 951 to 1211, y 590 to 670) with the text Sum 21. Between the trays, centred at x 728, y 300, one question mark in reddish purple #CC79A7 bold (140 px), with two thin curved construction grey #6B7280 arrows (3 px) below it, one pointing left and one pointing right, at y 380. No other text. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
any hint of the answer, such as an arrow between two particular cards or a highlighted pair
a card count other than 4 in each tray, or digits other than 1, 2, 7, 9 and 3, 4, 5, 9
images.takeaway: Two groups of cards have different sums, 19 and 21. Can one swap make them equal?
images.description: Two trays of number cards, Group 1 with 1, 2, 7, 9 and Group 2 with 3, 4, 5, 9, and the sums 19 and 21.
images.context: Hook image for Nazrana's Number Cards. It shows the numbers of the opening puzzle (a) of your maths book as small slips of paper in two groups.
images.teaching_notes: Do not point at the pair to swap. The picture only poses the question.

image_decisions.why: The hook story needs one clear picture of the two groups and their different sums, and nothing that gives the swap away.
